scope: Pre-generation art-direction cards, one prompt per raster candidate, pairwise visual-difference review, candidate-level science fidelity review, and the CI runner repair.
limitations: No image-generation request was made; actual model adherence to art-direction cards and rendered candidate diversity remain unverified.
No human blind preference study was conducted. Scores and candidate comparisons remain attributed subjective judgments.
Automated checks validate prompt-plan structure, review completeness, and arithmetic; they do not judge beauty or scientific truth.
No publisher acceptance or journal-specific aesthetic standard is claimed.
